component.name: DotScramble
component.summary: Blur faces, license plates and text in photos

description.p: DotScramble is a photo privacy studio: it hides what shouldn't be seen before you share a picture. Blur, pixelate or black-bar faces, eyes, license plates and text, and strip or replace the EXIF and GPS metadata hidden in the file. Your photos are processed on your computer and never uploaded.

ul.li: Detect faces, eyes, full bodies, license plates, any text, or one specific word, or draw the regions yourself
Seven effects: blur, pixelation, black bar, gradient, mosaic, frosted glass and oil paint
A detect preview that outlines every region before anything changes, so you can skip the ones you want to keep
Before / after compare, zoom and pan, live preview, undo and redo
Strip GPS, camera and device tags on save, or replace them with believable decoys
AI Evasion: an optimized pattern that hides faces from face detection software
Seven languages with right-to-left layouts, and sixteen themes

description.p: The core tools are free and open source. An optional Pro plan adds AI-powered detection, AI Evasion, the metadata tools and unlimited batches.
